fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: These terms apply to your use of this website. By using the site you accept them. If you do not accept them, please do not use the site.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Everything on this website is general information about dental treatment. It is not personal advice, it is not a diagnosis, and it is not a substitute for a consultation with a registered dental practitioner who has examined you.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Any dental or surgical procedure carries risks. Outcomes described here are typical rather than guaranteed, and individual results vary. Before proceeding with any treatment we encourage you to ask questions and, if you wish, to seek a second opinion from another qualified health practitioner.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Reading this site, or sending an enquiry through it, does not create a practitioner-patient relationship. That begins when you attend an appointment and we assess you.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Do not use this website or its enquiry form for urgent dental problems. Call us on {{site:phone}}. For facial swelling affecting breathing or swallowing, uncontrolled bleeding, a suspected broken jaw, or swelling spreading toward the eye or neck, call 000 or attend the nearest emergency department.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Prices and offers shown on this site are current at the date stated and may change without notice. The fee quoted in your written treatment plan is the fee that applies. Offers are subject to the conditions published alongside them, including any deposit, eligibility requirement and expiry.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: This site links to third parties including Services Australia, NSW Health, health funds and payment plan providers. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for their content, accuracy or privacy practices.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The content, design, images and code of this site belong to Tooth n Care or its licensors, and may not be reproduced without permission. Illustrative treatment images used on this site are not photographs of our patients unless expressly stated.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We take reasonable care to keep this site accurate and available, but we do not warrant that it is error-free or uninterrupted. To the extent permitted by law, and without excluding any rights you have under the Australian Consumer Law, we are not liable for loss arising from your use of this site.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: These terms are governed by the laws of New South Wales, Australia.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Questions about these terms can go to {{site:email}} or {{site:phone}}. [VERIFY] to be reviewed by the practice, and by a solicitor if the practice wishes, before going live.
